summary: Forestry Commission tower in Chester County: built by the CCC in 1939-40, replaced by a steel structure in 1957-58, and now listed as removed.

facts.status_note: Listed as removed on the Forest Lookouts site. No source gives a removal date or describes the site now.

events.note: 1939-40 state report (7/1/39 to 6/30/40): a new tower was built at the Chester site with Civilian Conservation Corps labor.
1957-58 state report (7/1/57 to 6/30/58): the old wooden tower was replaced by a new steel structure.

evidence.supports: 1939-40: Civilian Conservation Corps did all fire tower and telephone line construction that year
evidence.quote: All fire towers, tower buildings and telephone line construction was done by the Civilian Conservation Corps at no cost to the State or protective associations.

evidence.supports: 1939-40: a new tower was built at the Chester site
evidence.quote: A new tower was constructed at the Chester tower site in Chester County.

evidence.supports: The Corps completed the tower-unit buildings at the Chester site
evidence.quote: The C.C.C. completed tower unit buildings at the Chester tower site and others.

evidence.supports: Each tower unit had a four-room dwelling, barn, chicken house, smokehouse and latrine
evidence.quote: a four room dwelling, barn, chicken house, smokehouse and latrine.

evidence.supports: Most tower sites: 10 acres, plus the tower and a year-round dwelling for the operator
evidence.quote: Most tower sites consisted of 10 acres of land, the tower, and a year-round dwelling for the operator.

evidence.supports: 1957-58: old wooden tower replaced by a new steel structure
evidence.quote: The old wooden tower located at Chester was replaced by a new steel structure.

evidence.supports: All wooden towers were eventually replaced with steel
evidence.quote: Eventually, all wooden towers were replaced by steel structures.

evidence.supports: The commission closed its fire tower system on October 1, 1993
evidence.quote: The Forestry Commission closed its fire tower system on October 1, 1993.

evidence.supports: Status on the Forest Lookouts site: removed
Blog: the Chester Lookout Tower point comes from the GNIS place-name data
evidence.quote: The yellow pushpin shows the location for the Chester Lookout Tower in Chester County based on the GNIS data.

evidence.supports: Blog author did not know whether the Chester tower still stood
evidence.quote: the Chester tower is still standing

notes_for_editor: The 1939-40 and 1957-58 entries come from the Forest Lookouts transcript of State Commission of Forestry reports; the reports themselves were not read. The 'Removed' status has no date. The blog says a FFLA list puts the tower about 1.3 miles from the GNIS point our record uses, and thinks the GNIS point on Fire Tower Road is the likelier site, so location is unverified. The 1939 year is the start of the 1939-40 report year. No staffing, access, fire or new photo facts were found in the sources read.
